title: project.toml
description: The project: its name, the version requirement of the binary and the storage of each zone (MG-REQ-0362.1).

name.description: The project name, a lowercase identifier (MG-REQ-0305).

mergus.description: The version requirement of the Mergus binary, such as ">=1.4, <2".

gold.description: The storage of the gold zone.

raw.description: The storage of the raw zone.

ops.description: The storage of the ops zone.

zone.description: The storage of a zone: its profile and location, from which the catalog, the data path and the clients default (MG-REQ-0521).

profile.description: The storage profile of the zone: local, shared or cloud (MG-REQ-0521).

location.description: The location of the zone: a local directory for local and shared, an object-store URL for cloud.

catalog.description: Overrides the catalog: a path for local and shared, the secret reference of the PostgreSQL catalog for cloud, where it is required (MG-REQ-0521.1, MG-REQ-0521.2).

data_path.description: Overrides the directory or object-store prefix of the data files (MG-REQ-0521.2).

oneOf.description: A local zone: a DuckDB catalog in its location (MG-REQ-0521).
A shared zone: a SQLite catalog in its location (MG-REQ-0521).
A cloud zone: a PostgreSQL catalog from a secret reference, which it cannot default (MG-REQ-0521.1).

catalog.description: The secret reference of the PostgreSQL catalog.

secret.description: A secret reference secret:<name>, the name of MG-REQ-0305 (MG-REQ-1001).
